title: A second termal server process loads, recovers and queues a persist of the live state before it fails to bind its port
outcome: Starting `termal` in server mode while a host already runs on the same data directory cannot change that host's stored state: the second process refuses before it loads, recovers or persists anything, and says why.
acceptance: A first start on a free port and data directory still boots as today; the existing boot tests pass unchanged.

A second server start against a data directory whose host is running exits with a message naming the running instance, before load_state_for_boot, recover_interrupted_sessions or any persist request; a test covers it with a temp data directory and a held listener or instance lock.
The full gate passed on the exact landed input.
The state database's rows are byte-identical before and after that refused start; the same test checks it.

completion.summary: A server-mode termal start now takes an exclusive OS file lock on <data dir>/termal-server.lock before it loads, recovers or persists anything, and holds it in a process-lifetime static until the process exits. A second server on the same data directory, on any port, exits with a message naming the data directory, the lock file and the holder, and leaves the store untouched. Landed as 98ad64fd (fast-forward on f5a96582) with a credited full gate test-5be31ad4 on the exact input (diff 3c6ad9cc), review pairs clean at Medium and above, and evaluation affc34cb 4/4.
